experiment_plan.scope_basis: Same four task families and both MDP/POMDP modes as preceding experiments; this 24-run scope was stated to the user. No narrowing was requested.
experiment_plan.evaluation_policy: stochastic categorical; held-out reset keys; four episodes from each of 16 environments

ib.heads: current input plus posterior mean/log variance, without latent sampling
ib.objective: sum over actor/critic of sample mean(max(D_bits - 1, 0) / frozen_branch_RMS_bits), coefficient 1
ib.calibration: Fresh per task/mode/residual setting; 2048 random-policy samples, seed 900000; frozen scales specific to architecture. Do not reuse residual-enabled scales for the no-residual condition.

experiment_plan.vanilla_lru: No Gaussian bottleneck, no added inter-layer residual, no RMS normalization, no weight decay or state dropout; heads receive current input plus projected LRU output.
experiment_plan.training_settings: Retain upstream PPO-RNN hyperparameters; only total budget increases relative to the short pilot. Initial runs start from scratch, not from 100K pilot checkpoints.
experiment_plan.learning_rate_schedule: Initial 1M runs anneal over the full requested 1M budget (488 complete updates).
experiment_plan.preferred_accelerator: Colab T4 preferred; T4 allocation failed again (503). Trying L4; actual hardware is recorded per run. No local GPU training.

checkpoint_plan_and_implementation.rounding: First complete 2048-step rollout crossing each threshold; additionally save final state at 999424 steps.
checkpoint_plan_and_implementation.retention: Keep ALL periodic and final checkpoints. No rolling deletion. Never remove remote copies before confirming local checksummed copies.
sidecar_contents: full run metadata including frozen RMS calibration
checkpoint_plan_and_implementation.atomicity: Write state and metadata into a hidden temporary directory, then rename to publish. Restore scans only completed step directories and verifies checksums.
checkpoint_plan_and_implementation.same_budget_resume: Automatic from newest compatible local checkpoint. Rebuild optimizer template, restore its state, trim training/gradient log tail after the durable checkpoint, continue global update counter.
checkpoint_plan_and_implementation.extension_rules: Exactly one variant and seed; original source run stays intact. Only explicitly opted-in budget/schedule changes are accepted. Reuse frozen RMS calibration from the source checkpoint metadata.
checkpoint_plan_and_implementation.extension_schedule_policy: Default LR horizon becomes the newly requested total budget while optimizer counters and moments continue. This can jump the LR relative to the old nearly-finished horizon; it is recorded in metadata. --schedule-timesteps OLD_TOTAL keeps the old horizon instead.
checkpoint_plan_and_implementation.extension_compatibility: Configuration/source fingerprints must otherwise match; use the frozen source snapshot for later reproducibility. Do not treat extension as a run trained from scratch under the longer schedule.
checkpoint_plan_and_implementation.requires_for_practical_restore: Preserve the full run directory, logs, calibration, source snapshot, dependency lock, and checkpoint sidecars, not just final model weights.

gradient_logging.output: Run/gradient_norms.jsonl; gradient fields also appear in training.jsonl when enabled
gradient_logging.aggregation: Mean/max across PPO minibatches and epochs of the sampled rollout (normally 64 minibatches from 2048 environment steps), not an average across the entire intervening 10K-step window.
gradient_logging.cadence: First completed rollout crossing each 10K threshold, plus final rollout; approximately 100 records per 1M run and ten per checkpoint interval.
gradient_logging.complex_gradients: Norm uses complex magnitudes as optax.global_norm does.
